# Markdown to SPIP

> Convertisseur en ligne Markdown vers syntaxe SPIP, en temps réel. Gratuit, open source (GPL-3.0), sans inscription, sans tracking.

## Purpose

This web application converts Markdown syntax to SPIP syntax in real-time. It's designed for SPIP CMS users who want to write in Markdown and convert it to SPIP's native format.

SPIP (Système de Publication pour Internet Partagé) is a French open source CMS using its own markup syntax, distinct from Markdown.

## Key Features

- Real-time conversion (no submit button required)
- Split-view interface: Markdown input on left, SPIP output on right
- One-click copy to clipboard
- Persistent local text storage (browser localStorage, never sent to server beyond conversion)
- Theme: light, dark or system (follows OS preference, default)
- No personal data stored on server, only anonymous aggregate counters (GDPR-compliant)
- No tracking, no analytics, no cookies beyond Laravel session for CSRF
- Fully responsive (mobile/desktop)
- Public usage statistics page (transparency)
- Max 100,000 characters per conversion

## Supported Conversions

- Headings (h1): `# Title` → `{{{Title}}}`
- Subheadings (h2-h6): `## Title` → `{{Title}}`
- Bold: `**text**` or `__text__` → `{{text}}`
- Italic: `*text*` or `_text_` → `{text}`
- Bold + italic: `***text***` or `___text___` → `{{ { text } }}`
- Strikethrough: `~~text~~` → `<del>text</del>`
- Inline code: `` `code` `` → `<code>code</code>`
- Code blocks: ` ```code``` ` or ` ```lang code``` ` → `<code>code</code>`
- Links: `[text](url)` → `[text->url]`
- Bullet lists: `- item` → `-* item`
- Blockquotes: `> quote` → `<quote>quote</quote>`
- Footnotes: `text[^1]` + `[^1]: note` → `text[[note]]`

## Pages

- `/` — main converter (indexable)
- `/stats` — public usage statistics dashboard (noindex)
- `/mentions-legales` — legal notice (noindex)
- `/sitemap.xml` — sitemap with XSL styling
- `/robots.txt`

## Technical Stack

- Backend: Laravel 13 (PHP 8.4)
- Frontend: Livewire 4 (real-time server-driven UI)
- Styling: TailwindCSS 4
- JS: Alpine.js (minimal interactivity)
- Build: Vite 8
- Testing: PHPUnit 13 with `laravel/pao` for agent-optimized output
- Static analysis: Larastan/PHPStan level 10
- Code style: Laravel Pint

## Architecture

- Conversion logic isolated in `App\Support\MarkdownToSpipConverter` (pure, stateless, fully unit-tested)
- Real-time updates via Livewire `wire:model.live.debounce.50ms`
- Text is transmitted to server for conversion but never stored
- Rate limited (200 requests/minute per IP)
- Public usage stats stored in `storage/stats/stats.json` via `Storage::disk('stats')` with `flock` concurrency protection

## Installation

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Gallyan/md2spip.git
cd md2spip
composer run setup
php artisan serve
```

## Testing

70 automated tests covering:
- Unit tests for the conversion engine (`MarkdownToSpipConverter`)
- Feature tests for the Livewire component, stats dashboard, pages routing, stats seeder

```bash
php artisan test
```

## Privacy & GDPR

- No user tracking, no analytics, no advertising cookies
- Only functional cookies: Laravel session (CSRF protection), localStorage for user's draft text
- Online version: text sent to server for conversion, NOT stored
- Local version: everything stays on user's machine
- Public statistics (`/stats`) aggregate anonymous counters: visits, conversions (first character typed), copies, total copied characters
